waybackify site export [flags] <dir>

Export a cache root as a browsable path tree

Copy every stored body in a cache root to
<out>/<host>/<timestamp>/<path>, bytes untouched, with an
index.jsonl row per file (original URL, replay URL, document or
requisite, content type, digest). Bodiless sidecars are listed in
_unexported.jsonl. Paths that clash on a case-insensitive filesystem
are resolved the same way everywhere and listed in
_collisions.jsonl. Re-runs write only what changed.

Output: one JSON summary line on stdout.

Arguments:
  <dir>              the ledger the root was filled from (names the documents)

Flags:
  --root|-r <root>   cache root to read — required
  --out <dir>        directory to write the tree under (outside the root) — required
  --dry-run          plan and count; write nothing
  --help|-h          Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
